test_code = '''
import datetime as dt
from datetime import timezone, timedelta
from humanize.time import naturalday

# Patch date.today to return Oct 15
original_today = dt.date.today
dt.date.today = lambda: dt.date(2023, 10, 15)

try:
    tz = timezone(timedelta(hours=14))
    aware_dt = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 0, 0, tzinfo=tz)
    result = naturalday(aware_dt)
    print(f"Result: {result!r}")
finally:
    dt.date.today = original_today
'''
exec(test_code)
